notes.title: Quick Hotfix
notes.notes:
It seems we might have tested the last build with god mode activated... and accidentally disabled item consumption!
[b]Good news: it's now fixed.[/b]
You can eat and drink safely again! 🙌

notes.title: Hotfix: Player Inventory Restoration
notes.notes:
This hotfix resolves issues affecting the player inventory, ensuring proper functionality and item management.
Thanks!

notes.title: Alpha Guide Fix Update
notes.notes: This update includes fixes for the Alpha Guide system, ensuring proper functionality, even while driving vehicles.

notes.title: Minor Adjustments Update
notes.notes: This update includes small improvements and adjustments as we continue preparing for upcoming features. Thank you for your ongoing support.

notes.title: Small Patch for Performance and Immersion
notes.notes:
[b]New Features and Improvements[/b]
[list][*][b]Optimized Landscape and Vegetation Scatter Shadows[/b]: Enhanced overall performance by optimizing shadows for landscapes and scattered vegetation areas, ensuring smoother gameplay.
[*][b]Added Directional Signs Along Trails[/b]: New directional signs have been placed along main trails to aid players in navigating and exploring the map.
[/list] 
[b]Environment Updates[/b]
[list][*][b]Removed Vehicles for Enhanced Immersion[/b]: To further enhance the post-apocalyptic atmosphere, several vehicles have been removed from the map, deepening the immersive experience.
[/list] 
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list][*][b]Fixed Shader for Distant Grass[/b]: Resolved an issue where certain grass appeared overly bright at a distance.
[*][b]Fixed Z-Fighting in the Waterfall Area[/b]: Addressed graphical conflicts (z-fighting) in the waterfall area, creating a more visually appealing and realistic experience.[/list]

notes.title: Swimming, Zipline Descents, and Key Fixes Before Farming Update!
notes.notes:
Before the arrival of [b]farming in the next patch[/b], here are some [b]new features, improvements, and fixes[/b] that we invite you to try out now! 

[h2]Character [/h2]
- The character can now swim: watch out for your oxygen.

[h2]Vehicles [/h2]
- The Alpha Car is no longer a submarine. 
- The drone can no longer be used when in contact with water. 
- Fixed the bug where the Drone's post-process was displayed on all clients. 

[h2]Environment [/h2]
- The placeholder water volumes for the lakes have been replaced with the correct ones.

[h2]Gameplay [/h2]
- It is now possible to descend on a Zipline.
- The character's thirst decreases more slowly. 
- When the character is tired, we replaced the RGB post-process effect with a more natural one. 
- You can now set a tent or a bed as a respawn point. 

[h2]Miscellaneous [/h2]
- Modified the sound when deploying the tent. 
- The placeholder tent has been replaced with the Rooted tent mesh. 
- The "LOW SIGNAL" notification no longer stays on when the drone returns to the player's proximity. 
- Started work on the lighting: some artifacts or strange behaviors may appear at this stage.

Enjoy!

Mat

notes.title: Minor Update • Alpha 0.0.2.33

notes.title: Pilot drones, deal with energy, bug fixes and improvements 0.0.2.24
notes.notes:
[b]Version: Alpha 0.0.2.24[/b]
Published on: Sept 5th, 2024

[b]New Feature: QA / Alpha Tester Guide[/b]
- A guide for Alpha testers is now available in the TAB menu to help new players while we work on releasing the in-game tutorial. Be sure to check it out for tips and instructions!

[b]Vitals[/b]
- Character vitals are now correctly calculated even when inside vehicles.

[b]Gameplay[/b]
- The Police Drone is now pilotable.
- Fixed an issue where the respirator was blocking the use of the antidote injector.

[b]Vehicles[/b]
- The Alpha Car and Forklift now require Unicells, which can be found in the World.
- Death in a vehicle is now properly handled and no longer causes save file issues.
- Fixed pilot and passenger poses/positions for a more realistic in-game representation.
- Fixed forklift position and added a dedicated forklift pilot pose.
- Resolved an issue where the character was pulled back when entering a vehicle in FPS mode.
- Backpacks are now hidden inside vehicles to prevent visual clipping and other related bugs.

[b]Environment[/b]
- Initial implementation of US-style roads on the map.
- Added micro Points of Interest (POIs).

[b]Controller Overhaul[/b]
- Complete overhaul of controller bindings, icons, mapping, and multi-action support for a more intuitive and responsive gameplay experience.
- Drone is partially functional with the controller.

[b]FPS Improvement[/b]
- Smoother FPS experience, particularly when crouching, crawling, mantling, and vaulting.
- Fixed camera jumping latency when switching from TPS to FPS views.

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]
- After death, players now respawn with the correct clothing.
- Fixed barn doors in cinematics to ensure they function correctly.
- Resolved an issue where the flashlight was not properly destroyed after death or quitting the game.
- Backpacks are now destroyed when the player is destroyed.

notes.title: Improvements and Bug Fixes (Build 0.0.1.417)
notes.notes:
[h2]Route Improvements and Fixes:[/h2]
- Improved and Debugged Main Routes: Enhancement and debugging of several main routes.

[h2]Vehicle Enhancements:[/h2]
- Vehicle Interaction Bug Fix: Resolved the issue where client players would be teleported into the vehicle during an interaction.
- Alpha Car Flip View Added: Introduced a flip view for the Alpha Car camera (default key: V).
- Increased Vehicle Headlight Power: Enhanced the brightness of vehicle headlights.
- Forklift Piloting Bug Fix: Fixed the bug that caused the player's head to disappear while piloting a forklift.

[h2]Audio and Visual Adjustments:[/h2]
- Weather Volume Control Added: Added volume control for ambient weather sounds in the audio settings.
- Weather Cycle Adjustment: Modified the duration of the day/night cycle.

[h2]Guides and Missions:[/h2]
- Alpha Tester Guide Update: Stay on track with the Alpha test by completing the discovery missions outlined in the updated Alpha Tester Guide.

notes.title: New patch! Beyond the Monastery
notes.notes:
[h2]Optimization and Performance[/h2]
Performance Improvements: Numerous new elements such as the open world and many POIs have been added, requiring significant optimization. We are aware of the performance issues and are working on them. Please adjust your graphics settings for better performance and use Discord to provide feedback in the appropriate channels.

[h2]Important Information[/h2]
Save System and Bug Reporting: These features will be available soon again.
Map Loading Screens: Map loading screens are being reworked, resulting in temporarily less visually appealing load screens. This is expected.

[h2]Character Updates[/h2]

[list]
[*]Turn in Place Fix: Corrected the character's turn in place animation.
[*]Micro Movements Fix: Improved basin handling for small lateral movements.
[*]Vitals Update: Player vitals now include temperature.
[*]New Clothing Options: Added new clothing for characters.
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*]Ladders: Players can now use ladders.
[*]Day/Night Cycle: Introduced a realistic day and night cycle.
[*]Weather System: Added dynamic weather conditions.
[*]Resting in Tents: Players can now rest in tents.
[*]Open-World Expansion: Half of the map is now available for Alpha testing.
[*]Rooted Alpha Car: Available for alpha testers.
[*]Forklift Use: Players can now use forklifts.
[*]Deployables: Introduced deployable items, accessible via the Pie menu.
[/list]

[h2]Points of Interest (POIs)[/h2]
[list]
[*]Manor (WIP)
[*]Forest Cabin (WIP)
[*]Hunter Cabin (WIP)
[*]Observatory (Zone Under Construction)
[*]Zoo (Zone Under Construction)
[*]Communication Tower (Zone Under Construction)
[*]Resort (Zone Under Construction)
[*]Fisher Town (Zone Under Construction)
[/list]

[h2]Building, Crafting, and Farming[/h2]

Build System: The building system is not yet public, but the wood tier is available at the spawn point.

[b]Enjoy the new features and improvements in Rooted, and continue to share your feedback to help us enhance your gaming experience![/b]
